controls.fixtures: UUID temporary app-shaped bundles and zero-filled DMG-named files; pkgbuild creates a temporary genuine package and pkgutil queries its never-installed identifier

findings: Twenty original installer tests pass including matching/version heuristics, managed folders, ordering, parsing, missing metadata, injected cleanup and a real generated package with no receipt. Total distinct original tests passed across focused runs is 79.

DMG fixtures are zero-filled files named as disk images; successful matching demonstrates filename heuristic behavior, not disk-image content verification. Fake app bundles are temporary directories with authored Info.plist.
Generated package is built but never installed or executed. Tests do not cover source replacement after scan, app removal before cleanup, metadata beyond the eighth entry or subprocess timeouts.
